/**
 * @name File system operations in pathspec
 * @description Finding file system operations in the pathspec package
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/filesystem-operations
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "stat", "listdir", "walk", "scandir"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember(["Path"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("posixpath").getMember(["join", "normpath", "abspath", "realpath"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os.path").getMember(["join", "normpath", "abspath", "realpath"]).getACall()
select call, "File system or path operation found"
findings.hypothesis: Find file system operations in the package to understand potential sinks

message.text: File system or path operation found

/**
 * @name File system operations in pathspec
 * @description Find file system operations in the pathspec library
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/pathspec-fs-ops
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember([
    "open", "chdir", "mkdir", "makedirs", "remove", "rmdir", "removedirs",
    "rename", "replace", "stat", "lstat", "listdir", "scandir", "walk",
    "access", "chmod", "chown", "lchown", "link", "symlink", "readlink",
    "unlink", "utime"
  ]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os.path").getMember([
    "join", "abspath", "realpath", "normpath", "expanduser", "expandvars"
  ]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall()
select call, "File system or path operation: " + call.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Finding file system operations in pathspec library
